run_texify_app_cli: run the texify_app_cli function to start the Streamlit texify app in headless mode
build_streamlit_texify_app: build a Streamlit app by running texify_app_cli which launches texify_app.py via streamlit run
test_texify_app_cli: test the texify_app_cli function to verify it launches the Streamlit texify app correctly
refactor_texify_app_cli: refactor the texify_app_cli function to support custom streamlit arguments and environment variables
review_texify_app_cli: review the texify_app_cli function and its subprocess call to streamlit run
